During the game, players will try to gain Contracts by having the most money each round or by using Merchant’s skills. The first player to gain a required number of Contracts is the final winner. There are 15 merchants (12 merchants in the 2018 version of Hội Phố) with 15 unique skills and 5 Ship Cards. Players play a card simultaneously and compare reputation, the players who have the highest and second highest reputation merchant gain money while the lowest merchant triggers skill. Each round contains 4 turns (Player plays 4 out of 5 cards in hand). In a 5 player game, there are only 3 turns per round. Money and cards in hand are always hidden (unless the player is required to reveal it). Each Turn has the following steps: Put a card facedown - Reveal a card - Resolve and reward After finishing the last turn (the 4th turn in a game of 3-4 players or the 3rd turn in a game of 5 players), the round ends. All players reveal their money and the player with the most money gains 1 Contract card (the top one of the contract deck) Number of players: 3 - 5 Game duration: 14 mn Complexity: 2 / 5 Play Hội Phố (Second Edition) and 1414 other games online. [Rating: 5.5/10] Sort of trick taking, but with first place, second place and special powers for last place. Collect money, steal money, whoever has the most wins a contract. Whoever has the most contracts at the end works. Oddly contracts are more valuable as time goes on but in case of a tie, lowest value wins. Why not just have contracts get less valuable and high score wins? Felt too long for what it was providing.

[Rating: 6/10] Short card play game, feel like Love Letter/Citadels mix in small version. Each turn you choose card from hand to play, and then one player gets money, other player gets activate card ability. And you are trying get most contracts. It is short and quirky game, worth the try, but also it could become stale fast.
